_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Tú Imreoir {player_id} i Tic Tac Toe.
Is é do sprioc buaite triar as a chéile (cothrománach, ingearach, nó déanach) ar an mbord.
Ar do thurn, ba cheart duit uimhir cearnóige (0-8) a roghnaigh tú chun do mharc a chur ina dhiaidh.
Mar shampla, '[4]' do mharc a chur i gcill láir an bhoird.
Mar Imreoir {player_id}, beidh tú '{symbol}', agus do chéile comhraic '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ní leanann an t-aistriú a cuireadh isteach an cruth ceart.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ní cill bhailí é. Ní mór dó a bheith idir 0 agus 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Tá cealla {cell} á n-úsáid cheana féin.

game_action.placed: Chuir Imreoir {player_id} a shiombail ({symbol}) i gcill {cell}.
